name: Supreme x Nike Air Max Plus TN 'University Red'
story_html: Launching as part of the New York skate brand’s Fall/Winter 2020 collection, the Supreme x Nike Air Max Plus ‘Black’ features a mesh upper overlaid with gradient red and pink TPU fingers that spell out ‘Supreme’ on the side panels. A yellow mini-Swoosh is matched by Nike’s OG Tuned Air trademark on the heel, while Supreme’s signature box logo adorns the tongue. A similar color dynamic is utilized on the black foam midsole, enhanced with visible Max Air units and a TPU shank in a dark crimson hue.
